about: Starrett HB350 14 in bench optical comparator, self-made in Blender (sources/compar/build_compar.py) from dealer and auction photos (bidspotter, Surplus Record, AllSurplus listings found by image search) and the record's specs: the dark cast base on its feet with the X and Y handwheels and STARRETT lettering, the cross-slide and the 15.3 x 5 in stage with its T-slots and a part on it, the red housing with its deep hood round the 14 in screen (black bezel, graduated protractor ring, crosshair, chart clamps, rotation knob), the black panel below with the projection lens, switches and HB350 plate, the black profile illuminator at the left, and the red digital readout on its arm at the right (lit LED axes, keypad). Where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.comparator_14in) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-06: modelled against listing photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it
